en.title: Scorekeeper Management
en.excerpt: Complete guide to the scorekeeper role: account creation, target assignment, score input flow, corrections, and access control.

toc.text: Score Input Flow in the Field
Change of Session and Rotation of Officers

en.content:
What is Scorekeeper?

Scorekeeper is the officer responsible for entering archery scores digitally during the event. Every score entered is immediately synchronized to the public leaderboard in real-time, replacing manual recording on paper which is prone to errors.

🎯
Key Role in Score Integrity
Scorekeeper does not have access to event settings or overall participant data. They can only access assigned targets, maintaining security and data isolation.

Create a Scorekeeper Account

Only organization admins can create scorekeeper accounts. The account creation process is done from the event management dashboard:

  1. Go to Organization Dashboard → Events → [Event Name] → Scorekeeper.
  2. Click the Add Scorekeeper button.
  3. Fill in the officer's name, cellphone number or email, and assign to the desired target/session.
  4. The system will generate temporary login credentials (PIN or password) that can be shared with officers.
  5. The officer logs in via the mobile application or browser using these credentials.
Information Description
Maximum number Unlimited per event
Login method 6 digit PIN or email + password
Device Smartphone, tablet, or laptop
Offline access Automatically sync when connection is restored

Assignment to Target / Session

Each scorekeeper must be assigned to a specific target to avoid overlapping input. One scorekeeper can handle several targets simultaneously if team capacity is limited.

  • Assignment can be done before or during the event.
  • One target can be assigned to more than one scorekeeper (as a backup).
  • Changes in assignments will be immediately visible in the scorekeeper application.

Score Input Flow in the Field

After logging in, scorekeeper only sees the list of assigned targets. The following is the score input flow per end:

  1. Select Target — Select a target number from the list provided.
  2. Select End — Select the end number to be input (End 1, 2, 3, etc.).
  3. Input Each Arrow's Score — Enter the arrow values ​​one at a time (0–10, or X for 10 inner rings). The input order is from largest to smallest according to World Archery regulations.
  4. Total Confirmation — The system automatically totals the scores per end. Confirm if the total is correct.
  5. Submit — Score is saved and immediately appears on the public leaderboard.
✅
Double Verification
Before the score is sent, the system displays a summary of all arrows in one end. Scorekeeper must confirm before the data is stored permanently.

Score Correction & Cancellation

Input errors may occur in the field. archeris.net provides a controlled correction mechanism:

  • Immediate correction (within 5 minutes): Scorekeeper can immediately edit the newly input final score as long as the correction time window is still open.
  • Correction by admin: If the time window has expired, only the event admin can unlock the end and allow re-correction.
  • Correction history: Each score change is recorded along with the time, name of the scorekeeper, and reason for the correction for audit purposes.

Session Change and Officer Rotation

In multi-session events, the scorekeeper can be rotated between sessions without disturbing already stored data. Admin simply changes the assignment target on the dashboard before the next session starts. The new scorekeeper will immediately see the new target after re-logging in.

Access Control and Security

  • Data isolation: Scorekeeper can only view and input scores for assigned targets — no access to other participants' data.
  • Deactivate account: Admins can deactivate the scorekeeper account at any time from the event management dashboard.
  • PIN rotation: Change the PIN every event to prevent misuse of old credentials.
  • Activity log: All scorekeeper actions (logins, inputs, corrections) are recorded in a log that admins can access for audit purposes.

id.title: Manajemen Scorekeeper
id.excerpt: Panduan lengkap peran scorekeeper: pembuatan akun, assignment target, alur input skor, koreksi, dan kontrol akses.
id.content:
Apa Itu Scorekeeper?

Scorekeeper adalah petugas yang bertanggung jawab memasukkan skor panahan secara digital selama event berlangsung. Setiap skor yang diinput langsung tersinkronisasi ke leaderboard publik secara real-time, menggantikan pencatatan manual di kertas yang rawan kesalahan.

🎯
Peran Kunci dalam Integritas Skor
Scorekeeper tidak punya akses ke pengaturan event maupun data peserta secara keseluruhan. Mereka hanya dapat mengakses target yang ditugaskan, menjaga keamanan dan isolasi data.

Membuat Akun Scorekeeper

Hanya admin organisasi yang dapat membuat akun scorekeeper. Proses pembuatan akun dilakukan dari dasbor manajemen event:

  1. Buka Dasbor Organisasi → Event → [Nama Event] → Scorekeeper.
  2. Klik tombol Tambah Scorekeeper.
  3. Isi nama petugas, nomor HP atau email, dan assign ke target/sesi yang dikehendaki.
  4. Sistem akan mengenerate kredensial login sementara (PIN atau kata sandi) yang dapat dibagikan ke petugas.
  5. Petugas login melalui aplikasi mobile atau browser menggunakan kredensial tersebut.
Informasi Keterangan
Jumlah maksimum Tidak dibatasi per event
Metode login PIN 6 digit atau email + kata sandi
Perangkat Smartphone, tablet, atau laptop
Akses offline Tersinkronisasi otomatis saat koneksi pulih

Assignment ke Target / Sesi

Setiap scorekeeper harus di-assign ke target tertentu agar tidak terjadi tumpang tindih input. Satu scorekeeper bisa menangani beberapa target secara bersamaan jika kapasitas tim terbatas.

  • Assignment dapat dilakukan sebelum atau saat event berlangsung.
  • Satu target bisa diassign ke lebih dari satu scorekeeper (sebagai backup).
  • Perubahan assignment akan langsung terlihat di aplikasi scorekeeper.

Alur Input Skor di Lapangan

Setelah login, scorekeeper hanya melihat daftar target yang ditugaskan. Berikut alur input skor per end:

  1. Pilih Target — Pilih nomor target dari daftar yang tersedia.
  2. Pilih End — Pilih nomor end yang akan diinput (End 1, 2, 3, dst).
  3. Input Skor Tiap Panah — Masukkan nilai panah satu per satu (0–10, atau X untuk 10 ring dalam). Urutan input dari nilai terbesar ke terkecil sesuai ketentuan World Archery.
  4. Konfirmasi Total — Sistem otomatis menjumlah skor per end. Konfirmasi jika total sudah benar.
  5. Kirim — Skor tersimpan dan langsung muncul di leaderboard publik.
✅
Verifikasi Ganda
Sebelum skor dikirim, sistem menampilkan ringkasan semua panah dalam satu end. Scorekeeper wajib mengkonfirmasi sebelum data tersimpan permanen.

Koreksi & Pembatalan Skor

Kesalahan input dapat terjadi di lapangan. archeris.net menyediakan mekanisme koreksi yang terkontrol:

  • Koreksi segera (dalam 5 menit): Scorekeeper dapat langsung mengedit skor end yang baru diinput selama jendela waktu koreksi masih terbuka.
  • Koreksi oleh admin: Jika jendela waktu telah habis, hanya admin event yang dapat membuka kunci end dan mengizinkan koreksi ulang.
  • Riwayat koreksi: Setiap perubahan skor dicatat beserta waktu, nama scorekeeper, dan alasan koreksi untuk keperluan audit.

Pergantian Sesi dan Rotasi Petugas

Pada event multi-sesi, scorekeeper dapat dirotasi antar sesi tanpa mengganggu data yang sudah tersimpan. Admin cukup mengubah assignment target di dasbor sebelum sesi berikutnya dimulai. Scorekeeper baru akan langsung melihat target barunya setelah login ulang.

Kontrol Akses dan Keamanan

  • Isolasi data: Scorekeeper hanya dapat melihat dan menginput skor untuk target yang ditugaskan — tidak ada akses ke data peserta lain.
  • Non-aktifkan akun: Admin dapat menonaktifkan akun scorekeeper kapan saja dari dasbor manajemen event.
  • Rotasi PIN: Ganti PIN setiap event untuk mencegah penyalahgunaan kredensial lama.
  • Log aktivitas: Semua aksi scorekeeper (login, input, koreksi) tercatat dalam log yang dapat diakses admin untuk keperluan audit.
